_comment: FLUX.2 Klein generation parity against MFLUX 0.20 (guidance 1.0, flow_match_euler_discrete, untiled), shared by the Python exporter and the native checker and used for both variants. Text cases are complete text-to-image jobs; image cases are image-to-image jobs from the synthetic RGB-v1 starting image (KleinStartingImageCases.rgb), written as a PNG by the exporter. The exporter records MFLUX's compiled per-step latents and the pixels of its real generate_image, compiled and eager.
